title: Seen by AI
description: instantly place structures built by an AI and discover how it interacts with the game.
body:
_I asked ChaptGPT-5 to simulate worlds. After some fixing to make those sets work, it was all working perfectly!_

## What does it add specifically?

This datapack adds a total of 15 different sets of structures that simulate "worlds". **Use /function ai_worlds:world_[number] to place a set.** They all are unique in their own ways: loots, builds, mobs, etc..

More sets will be added over time. The main goal is to understand how an AI "sees" the game.
